limits: Post-hoc known-development diagnostic, no independent validation or photographic claim.
Single CFA phase and noise replicate, all three existing angles and both chromatic states/noise levels.
Identical Gaussian noise realizations across amplitudes; all arms and both seeds retained.
No optimizer, no training, no model selection, no threshold adjustment.
Gain change is corrected minus observed on identical noise, not a ratio of noisy estimates.
Fixed 3x3 CFA-plane blur witnesses at blends .25/.5/1 reuse the previous audit; no coefficient selected.
Witness loss uses the training equation on the same 32x32 packed core as transfer measurement, not the full training dataset.
A lower MSE with attenuation does not establish an objective implementation bug or prove the cause of the learned response.
